title: Concept: Gopher scheme echoed in a response
description: A gopher URL in the body in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Gopher sends arbitrary bytes to a target port, so a handler that resolves it can be turned into a way to talk to internal services that expect a binary protocol.
applicability: Deployments that render a gopher URL in the body into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Gopher sends arbitrary bytes to a target port, so a handler that resolves it can be turned into a way to talk to internal services that expect a binary protocol.
